digest.component_or_area: code quality audit remediation; CI reliability; documentation; graph traversal; module architecture
propositions: Python 3.11 xdist worker dies during test_opcert_service_app teardown due to a load-dependent pytest-xdist race condition (OSError on closed socket), not an app-code bug.
User-facing documentation teaches assignee/Jira-identity examples that are inconsistent with or unresolvable against docs/config.md.
Near-cap modules structured_run.py, compact.py, and event_append.py mix multiple responsibilities and layers, inflating file size and cyclomatic complexity toward the 800 LOC and CCN-15 caps.

Graph blocker subsystem (_find_direct_blockers, _get_all_blocked_by, check_cycle_at_level, detect_newly_unblocked) has duplicated BFS/loader infrastructure across functions, raising cyclomatic complexity above target thresholds.
The attest package contains untyped function signatures that fail strict mypy validation under --disallow-untyped-defs.

Structural decomposition by responsibility/layer, centralized loader/traversal logic, and typing remediation can reduce complexity debt while preserving public APIs and graph semantics without conflicts against the 212 other in-progress tickets.
